# AutoPilot Geo

> AI visibility platform that helps brands rank in ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI search engines through Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and auto-published SEO content.

AutoPilot Geo audits how a brand currently appears in AI answers, generates citation-ready content (answers, articles, local AEO pages, shopping Q&A), and auto-publishes it to the user's CMS so the brand keeps gaining mentions across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Gemini.
